purpose: Design base for a future 3D avatar representing ATOM visually during chat sessions. Not wired into any live UI yet — this manifest establishes the spec so a matching .glb can be authored/sourced later and dropped in with minimal code changes.

placeholder_preview.what_it_is: Standalone Three.js scene, free/local/no external upload — a boxy procedural humanoid robot built only from this manifest's color_palette and rough proportions (gunmetal torso, bronze shin guards/gloves, glowing cyan eyes, green chest badge). Not a real model of the reference photos, just a themed stand-in.
placeholder_preview.how_to_view: Open directly in a browser, or serve over the project's local Apache (XAMPP) at /model%20file/atom_avatar_preview.html
placeholder_preview.replace_when_ready: Once a real atom_robot_avatar.glb exists, load it with THREE.GLTFLoader instead of the procedural group in this file.

design_spec.style: hard-surface weathered sci-fi humanoid robot, realistic bipedal proportions (not chibi/stylized)
design_spec.head: rounded helmet-shaped head, two glowing oval eyes, worn tan headband-style plate across the forehead, small ridged vent on top
design_spec.torso: broad angular shoulder pauldrons, ribbed segmented chest plating, small chest badge reading 'Atom' in green script on the right panel
design_spec.arms: articulated segmented arms, tan/bronze gloved hands with exposed knuckle joints
design_spec.legs: robotic legs with tan/bronze shin guards carrying a triangular zigzag cutout pattern, dark heavy boots
design_spec.material_notes: matte worn metal with visible scratches/grime weathering, low-to-mid metalness, high roughness variance, no glossy/clean surfaces

existing_assets_in_this_folder.pixellabs-chibi-reaper-5295.glb: Not a style match for this spec (chibi proportions) — pre-existing asset, unrelated to this design, left as-is
existing_assets_in_this_folder.tiny_planet_friends_3d-chibi3d-2886.glb: Not a style match for this spec (chibi proportions) — pre-existing asset, unrelated to this design, left as-is

future_integration_plan_not_started: Web chat (frontend/web/chat.php): small avatar viewer panel near the chat header, loaded with Three.js GLTFLoader — same rendering approach already used for the admin dashboard's 3D Neural Brain Model (frontend/web/admin/index.php).
Idle animation: gentle rotation/breathing loop; eye-glow pulses while ATOM is composing or speaking a reply.
Desktop WPF (src/PersonalAIAssistant/): optional matching avatar viewport if a WPF-compatible 3D control is added later.
None of this is built yet — per instruction, this task only creates the design base for future use.
